label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows through URL decoding and conditional assignment to 'bar', which is then directly concatenated into SQL query string without sanitization. The switch statement always routes to 'C' case (guaranteed since guess="ABC"), making param=bar unconditional. Raw user input reaches SQL sink enabling injection.

evidence.note: User input extracted from header and URL-decoded
Switch statement with fixed target 'C' routes param to bar
SQL query constructed with unsanitized bar variable
